name: The END Game: Eradicating Neglected Diseases
source:
Step into the shoes of an infectious disease specialist. Your mission is to diagnose and treat patients suffering from three significant NTDs: visceral leishmaniasis, Chagas disease, and schistosomiasis. 

Through engaging storytelling and interactive gameplay, you will learn about the symptoms, transmission, and treatment of these diseases.  Apply your knowledge to make critical diagnostic decisions.

[From [url=https://achiuvisuals.itch.io/the-end-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
站在传染病专家的立场上。你的任务是诊断和治疗患有三种重要NTD的患者：内脏利什曼病、恰加斯病和血吸虫病。

通过引人入胜的故事讲述和互动游戏，你将了解这些疾病的症状、传播和治疗。应用你的知识做出关键的诊断决策。

[来自[url=https://achiuvisuals.itch.io/the-end-game]Itch.io[/url]]
